head_history: ringBuffer64 stores head getYRot; advances when deltaMovement.lengthSqr>=.005 or initially; stopped tick overwrites current slot. Part i uses history4+4*i. yBodyRot separately constrained±2deg; do not equate stored yaw with that clamped orientation.
world_segment_follow: Head server tick reconstructs/creates chain then traverses parents. Body tickMultipartPosition builds parent-front/back and own-back offsets, moves to midpoint, syncs pitch; height probes affect pitch limit10deg, not full foot IK or guaranteed collision solving.
height_limits: Low/high probes step.2 to roughly±3, fluids return0; prevHeight updates only when change>.2, pitch displacement clamped±.4. moveTo midpoint is not collision-resolved travel.
gait: BodyIndex i supplies leg phase(i+1)*pi*.5; front/back leg pairs differ+.5, left/right invert swing/flap. Body bob uses extra*pi*.5 multiplier on that phase. Tail also swings terminal appendages.
death: Model sets limbSwing=ageInTicks and limbSwingAmount=1 whenever deathTime>0; gait therefore does not decay torest. Renderers raise head byf*1 and body/tail byf*1.15 then rollZ up to180deg via sqrt((deathTime+partial-1)/20*1.6),clamped1.
replication: Body copies immediate parent hurt/deathTime server-side and sends MessageHurtMultipart. Three-argument packet ctor sets damageType empty; handler resolves damage registry before callback. Complete packet read, delivery/valid damageType not proven; no guaranteed client-synchronized death claimed.
server_tail_type: Head.createBody constructs EntityCentipedeBody for both body and tail EntityTypes; tail factory in registry constructs EntityCentipedeTail. Preserve side/factory distinction, do not infer a renderer cast failure without execution.
save: Head saves ChildUUID/SegCount; body saves ParentUUID/ChildUUID/BodyIndex/PartAngle/PartRadius. Parts[]/ring buffer/prevHeight not own-persisted. Own reused reader leaves UUID unchanged when tag absent. Reload topology recovery is not proven by field presence.
